label: AmpliFi Instant Router (AFI-INS-R)
description: Ubiquiti AmpliFi Instant mesh router - one Gigabit WAN port and one Gigabit LAN port, 802.11ac 2x2 up to 866.7 Mbps on 5 GHz and 802.11n up to 300 Mbps on 2.4 GHz, colour touchscreen, mesh expandable with AmpliFi MeshPoints. 802.11ac; WPA2-PSK.
notes: The page says 'one Gigabit Ethernet port, a WAN port', and both halves matter: this is a **two-socket** router - one WAN and exactly one LAN - so a lab that expects a four-port home router is wrong about the hardware, and the second wired device needs a switch. The radio rates are quoted rather than inferred this time: 802.11ac '13 Mbps to 866.7 Mbps (MCS0 - MCS9, VHT 20/40/80)' and 802.11n '6.5 Mbps to 300 Mbps'. No PoE in or out (the ports say `poeIn: 0` explicitly so the engine's access-point heuristic does not invent a draw), and no console - it is managed from the AmpliFi app and the touchscreen, so no `cli` capability.
